What We Create

A Cake for Every Celebration

From intimate gatherings to grand events — we design cakes that match your vision perfectly.

Birthdays

Themed designs, character cakes, milestone celebrations — we make your birthday one to remember forever.

Weddings

Elegant tiered masterpieces — floral, minimalist, or lavish — tailored perfectly to your wedding aesthetic.

Baby Showers

Soft pastels, adorable themes, gender reveals — sweet cakes for the sweetest, most precious moments.

Anniversaries

Celebrate love milestones with romantic designs — monograms, florals, and timeless elegance for two.

Graduations

Cap and scroll, school colors, achievement themes — celebrate your grad in the sweetest possible style.

Corporate Events

Branded cakes, logo designs, team celebrations — professional, impressive, and absolutely delicious.

The Process

Ordering Is Simple

Three easy steps from your idea to your celebration — we handle all the delicious magic in between.

1

Share Your Vision

Call or message us with your event date, occasion, guest count, and any design ideas. Photos and inspiration are totally welcome!

2

We Design & Bake

We sketch a custom design for your approval, then bake every layer fresh from scratch using only premium, quality ingredients.

3

Delivered to You

Your cake arrives beautifully boxed and ready to wow your guests. Local delivery or convenient studio pickup — your choice.

Meet the Baker

Baked with Passion

Hi! I'm Sophia Rivera, and I've been turning flour, butter, and dreams into edible art for over 8 years. What started as baking birthday cakes for family has grown into a full-time cake studio serving hundreds of families across the city.

I believe every celebration deserves a cake as unique as the person being celebrated. That's why every order is truly custom — no two cakes ever look exactly alike. I put my whole heart into every tier, petal, and swirl.

Questions

Frequently Asked

We recommend ordering at least 2–3 weeks in advance for standard cakes, and 4–6 weeks for wedding or tiered cakes. During peak season (May–June, Nov–Dec) book earlier to secure your date.

We offer local delivery within the city and surrounding areas. Delivery fees depend on distance. Studio pickup is also available — we'll coordinate a convenient time with you.

Yes! We offer gluten-free and egg-free options. Please note we bake in a kitchen that handles gluten, nuts, and dairy — we can't guarantee a fully allergen-free environment. Let us know your requirements when ordering.

Just call or text us with your event date, number of guests, flavor preferences, and any design ideas or photos. We'll get back to you with a quote within 24 hours!

We require a 50% deposit to secure your date, with the balance due one week before your event. We accept Venmo, Zelle, cash, or card. Deposits are non-refundable if cancelled within 7 days of your event.
